svg.title: Red Sea winter and summer local section feasibility
svg.desc: Winter40–80m-above-bottom observations support a local half-peak southward component span near6km using casts7,8,9. The primary20–60m layer needs quality-questioned cast10 and remains unresolved. Summer lacks comparable usable support. Circles/solid lines identify20–60m, squares/dashed lines40–80m. Salinity panels show independent water-property context. Neither a physical full-current width nor an annual range is admitted. All scenarios, missing profiles and numerical values are available in the companion JSON and plan.
